text: 🔥🇲🇽 "I invite you to eat, we talk — but it's very different from you coming into my house, wanting the kitchen, the bedroom, and running my house." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on Chihuahua's 2022 agreement with Texas Governor Maru Campos signed a deal with Texas covering migration, security, drug/arms trafficking, and US agency participation. Sheinbaum: "It's strange — those are state governments, and the agencies are federal."

🇲🇽⚖️ "In Mexico, Mexicans decide." — Claudia Sheinbaum, backing initiative to nullify elections tainted by foreign interference Ricardo Monreal's proposed reform: if foreign interference in Mexican elections is demonstrated, INE or the Electoral Tribunal can declare them null. Sheinbaum endorsed it immediately.

🇲🇽🎨 "The European Commission president arrives and the first thing she wants is the Anthropology Museum and to meet indigenous women." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on von der Leyen's visit Updated EU-Mexico Global Trade Agreement signed today. Sheinbaum responded to a column calling it "false indigenismo": the original mestizaje was brutal, forced, violent. The celebration of indigenous heritage honors their grandeur in sports, culture, and dignity.

🇲🇽🌎 "Collaboration between the US and Mexico is exactly that — collaboration, coordination. There is no subordination." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on meeting with US DHS US officials acknowledged Mexico's security work. More frequent Security Understanding meetings proposed. Framework limited by Constitution — joint operations on Mexican territory not permitted.

🇲🇽🌎 "Evo Morales' government was the best Bolivia has ever had — and the results speak for themselves." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on US charges against Raúl Castro and persecution of Evo Morales GDP up. Income up. Poverty down. Inequality down. Sovereignty over natural resources strengthened. Sheinbaum cited ex-president Miguel de la Madrid's memoirs: "The US has always used drug trafficking as a pretext for intervention."

🇲🇽✊ "Mexican women in the US contribute more than a trillion dollars a year." — Ana Valdez, Latino Donor Collaborative 14.1M Mexican women in the US. 69% workforce participation. 82% focused on building wealth. 1 in 4 women under 18 is Latina — majority Mexican origin. By 2060, 30% of all US women will be Latina.

🇲🇽🏃‍♀️ "We are unstoppable women. Two first places, breaking records." "Somos mujeres imparables. Dos primeros lugares, rompiendo récord." — Miriam Morales, Mixtec ambassador, México Imparable Five indigenous women — two Mixtec, three Rarámuri — competed at the 23rd Great Wall of China Marathon. 60+ countries participated. Gold and silver medals for Mexico.
📸 Mañanera del Pueblo — 22 de mayo de 2026

GDP REVISION: MEXICO'S Q1 CONTRACTION WAS -0.6%, NOT -0.8% — BETTER THAN EXPECTED

INEGI's final Q1 2026 GDP figure: -0.6% quarterly. Beats both the preliminary -0.8% reading and Bloomberg's analyst consensus of -0.8%. Manufacturing took the hit (-1.0%), agriculture fell -1.7%, but the economy proved more resilient than anyone predicted.

Context: this is amid Trump tariffs at historic highs, oil volatility from the Iran conflict, and a global trade war. Mexico's fundamentals held. The EU trade deal signed today adds diversification. Banxico expects adjusted growth below 1% for 2026 — but the recession narrative keeps crumbling one revision at a time.
